title: Marica
summary: Raleigh names Marica in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Marica, the Nymph by whom Virgil giues Latinus to Faunus as his Sonne. Her abode was about the Riuer Liris neere Minturnae. No yeere of the World was taken for her. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XXIV, §. III, sig. 347b
